container.$description: A box that holds other components: panels in a page, and popups such as the palette and which-key. See docs/decisions/0015-containers.md.

padding-block.$description: Top and bottom inset of a text container, so it is always a whole number of lines tall.

padding-inline.$description: Left and right inset of a text container.

tight-padding.$description: Inset on all sides of a tight container, for widgets whose items are markers with their own padding, as in the bar.

offset.$description: Space between a popup and the screen edges and status bar, as between the desktop bar and the screen.
